name: Jason, Coming of Age
source:
In this game, you’ll play as 25-year-old Jason, a young man just getting started in life. While “adulting”, Jason will embark upon a perilous adventure, accompanied by his longtime friends.

The story begins in the summer of 2021. It’s an important inflection point for Jason, as he moves into his first apartment and is poised to kick off his career at a small local newspaper as a computer technician.

A friend’s little sister seems to be showing a sudden interest in him…how far will it go? Of course, the same could be said for all the ladies he encounters in the neighborhood…and at the office! Where is this sudden power of chick-magnetism coming from? What’s Jason’s secret? I bet you’d want a piece of that action!
translation:
你將扮演25歲的傑森。屬於他自己的人生才剛起步，他一邊摸索怎麼「當個大人」，一邊在相識多年的朋友陪伴下，踏上一段危機四伏的冒險。

故事開始於2021年夏天。這是傑森人生中的一個重要轉折點：他搬進了自己的第一間公寓，也即將到當地一家小報社擔任電腦技術員，正式開始職業生涯。

朋友的妹妹似乎突然對他有了興趣……這段關係會發展到什麼地步？話說回來，不論是在街坊鄰里，還是在辦公室，他遇見的其他女士好像也一樣！這股突然冒出來的桃花運是從哪兒來的？傑森到底有什麼秘密？我敢打賭，你也想來分一杯羹！
